summary.content:
Today's selection covers 104 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 70 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: You can now remix other people’s YouTube Shorts with AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Verizon DBIR: Enterprises Face a Dangerous Vulnerability Glut
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 75 articles published in the last 24 hours
